name: graphwing-implement-slice
description: Walks one bounded mechanical pre-PR slice using the declared trigger inputs and durable build_id/event_id state, exact event replay, and a tenant CAS lease before local effects. gitStatus → gitCheckout → sliceFrontier → durable routing-policy → agentRun → testRun → sliceComplete → gitCommit/gitPush. Rewst records the sanitized terminal result and advances only new/pre_pr to pre_pr or pre_pr_complete. Verified route evidence is persisted by the policy, active corrections never redraw, and failures park with files kept. Chained webhook continuation remains known-disabled. Visual and preview lifecycle are not part of this slice.
